text.offer: Solomon says, "You buy reagents from me, so you must be a mage. Then you ought to know about the Sentinel. Out past the King's Way and up into the Cragged Mountains, beyond an ancient place nobody remembers building, there stands a great stone Sentinel. In its shadow is a mana node."
text.progress: From Cor Noth: the outskirts, the King's Way, the Cragged Mountains, the ancient place, then Under the shadow of the Sentinel.
text.complete: Good, good. Now you'll need more reagents than ever. You know where to find me.

steps.objective: Bond with the node under the Sentinel
